title: Long Name
paragraphs: “But… after witnessing Iwatani-dono’s threats, I realized it was far more effective than simply killing with a sword.”

“I do think they need to face the consequences, but doing it in front of Imiya-chan didn’t sit right with me… We’ve captured them, so all that’s left is to take them to Faubrey. We absolutely cannot allow something like this to be forgiven.”
When Father said that, Ren and Itsuki both nodded.
“U-Um…”
Mole called out to Father.
“What’s wrong? Are you hungry?”
“N-No… um, I… I also…”
Mole’s gaze shifted toward Assistant. Since it’s dark now, it seems they don’t need sunglasses, but wouldn’t it be too bright for them during the day?
“Do you want to become stronger, like Wyndia-chan?”
“Y-Yes…”
“Is that… for revenge?”
When Father asked, Mole shook their head.
“Um… If you find my family and we’re able to be together again… If something like this happens again, I want to be able to protect them…”

“I see… Well, if it’s just leveling up alongside Wyndia-chan and Gaelion-chan, then that’s fine. But… I also want you to learn what power can lead to. It’s something I struggle with constantly myself.”
“Okay.”
Father extended his hand, and Mole reached out and shook it.
“Another companion added to Naofumi’s circle, huh?”
“It’s not like Imiya-chan is exclusively my companion. Gaelion-chan, on the other hand, seems to prefer me and Wyndia-chan.”
“Um…”
Mole was hiding behind Father, just like Assistant.
“It’s okay. Everyone was there when we saved you, right? They’re kind people who get angry at injustice.”
“Ah… Yes… Please take care of me.”
“Likewise. You’re from an unusual race, but I hear you’re quite skilled with your hands?”
“They’re a Lumo. From what Father told me, they have dexterous hands and can use earth magic.”

“Alright, let’s start with introductions. My name is Naofumi Iwatani. The one over there with the bow is Itsuki Kawasumi, the boy with the sword is Ren Amaki, and the beautiful woman is Eclair. Eclair, your last name was Seaetto, right?”
“Iwatani-dono! D-Don’t call me beautiful! Besides, I stand in a position where I should be resented. My name is of no importance… perhaps it’s better if it isn’t even known.”
Mole tilted their head in confusion.
“There you go again, being all serious… But it’s not like you did anything wrong, Eclair. Your father was only trying to protect everyone, and things just turned out that way.”
“Even so, I must apologize. I must be resented. Because I failed to protect them.”
The atmosphere grew heavy. Éclair is so serious. I think she should take things a little easier.
“What do you mean by that?”
“Hmm… Imiya-chan, do you know why you ended up in such misfortune? Do you understand the original reason?”
“Um, the adults said it was because the lord tried to protect everyone and passed away.”
“Yeah… He fought bravely to protect everyone and died. Eclair is his daughter. And now, she believes she has an obligation to be resented in place of her father, who couldn’t protect everyone.”
Hearing Father’s explanation, Mole looked at Éclair.
“But she saved me.”
“Yeah, that’s right. But Eclair thinks that if her father hadn’t died, you might not have had to suffer misfortune. Do you understand?”
“Hmm…?”
It seems they didn’t quite get it. Father spoke gently, as if explaining to a child.
“But I don’t think she did anything wrong.”

“Imiya-chan, you’re very kind. That’s right—if we’re talking about who’s at fault, it’s obviously the ones who engaged in slave hunting. The people behind them, too. Eclair is actually opposed to those people. She truly cares about you and your people.”
As Father patted Mole’s head, she blushed slightly.
“Iwatani-dono… thank you.”
After that, Father subtly gestured toward Assistant and Sakura-chan. It was time to continue the introductions.
“Um, my name is Wyndia.”
“Gaou!”
“This one is Gaelion.”
Then, Sakura-chan and the others stood up.
“I’m Sakura!”
“My name is Yuki.”
“Kou…”
Kou was staring at Mole, drooling. Father furrowed his brows at Kou.
“Alright, Imiya-chan, introduce yourself now.”
“…Imiya Lysrun Leecera Tereti Quarlies…”
“T-That’s long…” Ren and Éclair muttered.
“Um, is it alright if we just call you Imiya-san?”
Itsuki smoothly moved past it. Mole nodded.
“Is this a unique cultural trait of the Lumo race?”
“I’ve only heard about it in stories, but apparently, there are races that pass down long names through generations.”
“I see. We have similar customs in our world too. This must be a longer version of that.”
“Weren’t there strangely long anime character names when we were kids?”
“Oh yeah. I think… Moge? Sanatabitch… Robin Sasquatch… Hmm, I can’t remember.”
“And yet, you can memorize a recipe just by glancing at it,” Ren said that to Father, who responded with a wry smile.
“Well, I do know Churbo Chade Asperge Verte et Jus d’Asperge.”
What kind of incantation is that? It sounds like a powerful defensive spell is about to activate.
“Why is it that you can rattle off dish names so fluently!?”
“And by the way, what even is that?”
Ren pointed at Father, and Itsuki asked in exasperation. As expected of Father. I wouldn’t be able to remember a single letter of that.
“In Japanese, it’s Warm Flounder and Asparagus with Asparagus Sauce.”
“Hah… Naofumi, you really are strange.”
“I’ll make it for you next time. Well, it’ll just be something similar, though.”
“You even know how to make it? Just how much do you know…?”
“Is it tasty?”
“Imiya-chan’s name isn’t edible, but the dish… Well, the quality varies, but if you go to a good place, it should be delicious.”
Father reassured Sakura-chan in response to her question. While we were chatting, Assistant and Mole began nodding off. By then, the conversation had shifted to discussing our future plans.

“We’ve confirmed the dark dealings of Melromarc. A country that pulls off something like this… No, rather, a religion without true justice. We should take this information to Faubrey and testify against them.”
Ren said this, and Itsuki nodded.
“Yes. Just as Éclair mentioned, there are people in the country who try to protect demi-humans. That’s why we have to put an end to the Three Heroes Church, which is the root of the problem.”

“With all the investigation we’ve done in Melromarc and our journey to Faubrey… it’s almost been a month since we were summoned. The timing is just right—once we deal with the next Wave, we’ll head straight to Faubrey.”
“Yeah!”
“I’m in!”
“That said, the people in the nearby regions need to experience the terror of the Wave firsthand. I think timing is crucial.”

“Even if we prioritize saving lives, people need to stop relying on the Heroes to come and rescue them immediately. Fortunately, we know where the Wave will strike. It might be better to let a few slip through.”
“Saving everyone completely might not be ideal, but ignoring them isn’t an option either… This really is difficult.”
“Yeah…”
“I shall protect the Filolials! There is a Filolial ranch in that village, after all.”
“Oh, really? That’s important too. Then, Motoyasu, I’ll leave that to you.”
“Leave it to me!”
And so, we continued discussing. Ren and Itsuki also agreed that I should protect the Filolials. It was a very productive strategy meeting.
“Alright then, Wyndia-chan, Imiya-chan, it’s time for bed.”
“Mmhh…”
Mole was whining, unwilling to part from Father. For demi-humans and beastmen, Father, the Shield Hero, is a legendary figure from the stories passed down through generations.
“Alright, alright. I’ll tell you a story until you fall asleep.”
Saying this, Father led Assistant and Mole into the wagon we had prepared locally.
“He’s completely turned into a caretaker, hasn’t he?”
“Yeah. His nurturing nature and the way non-humans gravitate toward him… He truly fits the role of the Shield Hero.”
“If we keep talking, he’ll glare at us. Let’s stay quiet.”
“Agreed.”
After that, Ren and Itsuki really did fall silent. Father had a complicated expression on his face. And so, the night gradually deepened.
